description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
